node.statement: Delta-unit branch. In the fixed datum, lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation gives v:B->A as an extended delta-isomorphism with delta=C_E*epsilon_AI(eta), gives 0<=epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta, and def-routef-raw-factor-setting gives tilde-Delta=inclusion_{A subset B(H)} composed with v. The unit clause of the delta-homomorphism contained in the registered definition def-extended-delta-inclusion yields ||v(I_B)-I_A||<=delta. Since bar C_E=max{1,C_E}, delta<=bar C_E*C_A*eta=C_V*eta; A has the inherited unit I_A=I_{B(H)}, so ||tilde-Delta(I_B)-I_{B(H)}||<=C_V*eta<=C_T*eta.
